# fvipers (Fighting Vipers, Revision D; Model 2B-CRX): entry points the
# recompiler cannot find by itself. The MAME harvest (scripts/run_trace.sh's
# branches.txt: the targets of indirect branches, calls and balx, the interrupt
# handlers and the IAC target) over attract and a scripted fight (MAME -nodrc);
# the interrupted addresses are not seeds. Addresses only (our own analysis;
# rules.md rule 7).
